def $ppterminator_token(eps) = 0

def $ppterminator_token(metadataEntry :: metadata) = $ppterminator_token(metadata)
  -- if ~$ppterminator_tag(metadataEntry)
dec $ppterminator_range(int, int, int) : int
def $ppterminator_range(z, z_start, z_end) = z
  -- if $(z > 0 /\ z_start > 0 /\ z >= z_start /\ z <= z_end)
def $ppterminator_range(z, z_start, z_end) = 0
  -- otherwise
dec $ppterminator(metadata) : int
def $ppterminator(metadata) = $ppterminator_range($ppterminator_token(metadata), $source_line(metadata), $source_end_line(metadata))

def $ppstart(n, program, ptbytes) = $pplexical({ LOOPS 0, HEADERASSIGNED false, CVS eps, AUTOGLOBALS eps, FOLD $pfbegin(n, program), ENV $plempty(false), LOCATION { UNIT n, PATH eps, FILE ptbytes, LINE 1 }, COMPLETION PPCNORMAL, DIAGNOSTICS eps, WORK eps, WRITES eps, EXPRESSIONS eps, ACCESS eps, NAMES eps, REDIRECTS eps }, $plstart(n, program, ptbytes))
def $pplexical(P, plresult) = P
  -- if P.COMPLETION =/= PPCNORMAL
def $pplexical(P, PLDONE plstate pldiagnostic*) = P[.ENV = plstate.ENV][.DIAGNOSTICS = P.DIAGNOSTICS ++ pldiagnostic*]
  -- if P.COMPLETION = PPCNORMAL
def $pplexical(P, PLERROR pldiagnostic*) = P[.DIAGNOSTICS = P.DIAGNOSTICS ++ pldiagnostic*][.COMPLETION = PPCNAMESPACE]
  -- if P.COMPLETION = PPCNORMAL
def $pplexical(P, PLUNSUPPORTED text) = $ppunsupported(P, text)
  -- if P.COMPLETION = PPCNORMAL
def $pplexical(P, PLWORK (PCOCCURRENCE pcpath pcnode) plstate pldiagnostic*) = $ppresume(P_compiled, plstate, pcpath, statement, plstate.ENV)
  -- if P.COMPLETION = PPCNORMAL
  -- if pcnode = statement
  -- if P_compiled = $ppstatement(P[.ENV = plstate.ENV][.DIAGNOSTICS = P.DIAGNOSTICS ++ pldiagnostic*], pcpath, statement)
def $ppresume(P, plstate, pcpath, statement, plenv) = P
  -- if P.COMPLETION =/= PPCNORMAL
def $ppresume(P, plstate, pcpath, statement, plenv) = $pplexical(P[.WORK = P.WORK ++ [PPCWORK pcpath statement plenv P.LOCATION.LINE]], $plresume(plstate, PLCOMPILED (P.LOCATION[.PATH = pcpath]) P.ENV))
  -- if P.COMPLETION = PPCNORMAL

def $pplocate(P, pcpath, z) = P[.LOCATION = P.LOCATION[.PATH = pcpath][.LINE = n]]
  -- if $(z > 0)
  -- if z = n
def $pplocate(P, pcpath, z) = $ppunsupported(P, "missing ordinary compiler line")
  -- if $(z <= 0)
def $ppcheck(P, pcheck) = P
  -- if P.COMPLETION =/= PPCNORMAL
def $ppcheck(P, READY) = P
  -- if P.COMPLETION = PPCNORMAL
def $ppcheck(P, REJECT pcompletion) = P[.COMPLETION = PPCABRUPT pcompletion]
  -- if P.COMPLETION = PPCNORMAL
def $ppunsupported(P, text) = P[.COMPLETION = PPCABRUPT (UNSUPPORTED text)]
def $ppfoldresult(P, F) = P[.FOLD = F[.WARNINGS = eps]][.DIAGNOSTICS = P.DIAGNOSTICS ++ $ppfoldwarnings(F.WARNINGS, P.LOCATION)]
  -- if F.MEMORY.COMPLETION = NORMAL
def $ppfoldresult(P, F) = P[.FOLD = F[.WARNINGS = eps]][.DIAGNOSTICS = P.DIAGNOSTICS ++ $ppfoldwarnings(F.WARNINGS, P.LOCATION)][.COMPLETION = PPCABRUPT F.MEMORY.COMPLETION]
  -- if F.MEMORY.COMPLETION =/= NORMAL

def $ppoperandresult(P, F) = $ppfoldresult(P, F[.FACTS = P.FOLD.FACTS])

def $ppstatement(P, pcpath, statement) = P

def $ppstatement(P, pcpath, NStmtNop metadata) = P
  -- if P.COMPLETION = PPCNORMAL

  -- if P.COMPLETION = PPCNORMAL
def $ppstatement(P, pcpath, NStmtExpression expression metadata) = $ppexpr(P, pcpath ++ [PCFIELD 0], expression, PPR)
  -- if P.COMPLETION = PPCNORMAL
def $ppstatement(P, pcpath, NStmtEcho (SEQUENCE expression*) metadata) = $ppexprs(P, pcpath ++ [PCFIELD 0], 0, expression*, PPR)
  -- if P.COMPLETION = PPCNORMAL
def $ppstatement(P, pcpath, NStmtUnset (SEQUENCE expression*) metadata) = $ppunsetexprs($pplocate(P, pcpath, $source_line(metadata)), pcpath ++ [PCFIELD 0], 0, expression*)
  -- if P.COMPLETION = PPCNORMAL
def $ppstatement(P, pcpath, NStmtBlock (SEQUENCE statement*) metadata) = $ppstatements($pplocate(P, pcpath, $source_end_line(metadata)), pcpath ++ [PCFIELD 0], 0, statement*)
  -- if P.COMPLETION = PPCNORMAL
def $ppstatement(P, pcpath, statement) = $ppunsupported(P, "ordinary statement compilation")
  -- otherwise

def $ppstatements(P, pcpath, n, eps) = P
def $ppstatements(P, pcpath, n, statement :: statement_tail*) = $ppstatements($ppstatement(P, pcpath ++ [PCINDEX n], statement), pcpath, $(n + 1), statement_tail*)
def $ppexprs(P, pcpath, n, eps, ppmode) = P
def $ppexprs(P, pcpath, n, expression :: expression_tail*, ppmode) = $ppexprs($ppexpr(P, pcpath ++ [PCINDEX n], expression, ppmode), pcpath, $(n + 1), expression_tail*, ppmode)

;; Only final unset variables reject $this; dimension bases still perform FETCH_THIS.
def $ppunsetexprs(P, pcpath, n, eps) = P
def $ppunsetexprs(P, pcpath, n, expression :: expression_tail*) = $ppunsetexprs($ppexpr($ppunsetcheck($pplocate(P, pcpath ++ [PCINDEX n], $expression_line(expression)), expression), pcpath ++ [PCINDEX n], expression, PPUNSET), pcpath, $(n + 1), expression_tail*)
def $ppunsetcheck(P, NExprVariable phpType32 metadata) = $ppcheck(P, $context_error("Cannot unset $this", P.LOCATION.LINE))
  -- if $cv_name(phpType32) = ([116,104,105,115])
def $ppunsetcheck(P, expression) = $ppupdatecheck(P, expression) -- otherwise

def $ppexpr(P, pcpath, expression, ppmode) = P

def $ppexpr(P, pcpath, expression, ppmode) = $ppdone($ppexprbody($pplocate(P, pcpath, $ppeffective_line(P.FOLD.FACTS, pcpath, expression, ppmode)), pcpath, expression, ppmode), pcpath, ppmode)
  -- if P.COMPLETION = PPCNORMAL

  -- if P.COMPLETION =/= PPCNORMAL
def $ppdone(P, pcpath, ppmode) = P[.EXPRESSIONS = P.EXPRESSIONS ++ [PPCEXPR pcpath P.LOCATION.LINE P.FOLD.VALUE]][.ACCESS = P.ACCESS ++ [(pcpath, ppmode)]]
  -- if P.COMPLETION = PPCNORMAL

  -- if $pffact(P.FOLD.FACTS, pcpath) = (pvalue)
